name: v0.50.0 - Analyzer Compatibility and Adoption Hardening
description: Focused adoption-hardening release for the EF Core library surface after v0.49.0. Scope: reduce analyzer friction for .NET 8 build hosts where feasible, make the optional privacy extension more practically adoptable without owning compliance or provider-native encryption, and turn the binary hash-key migration manifest into a deterministic validation/preflight aid. Planning release v0.50.0 maps to package versions 8.50.0 and 10.50.0.
